A '''High Priest of Dim-U''' was a member of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] during [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk's]] tenure as [[Guild Master/Legends|guildmaster]]. [[Ro-San Borokki]], the Guild's Director of Training, praised both his use of a [[Crossbow/Legends|crossbow]] and his ability to convince fellow religious beings to turn themselves in.<ref name="Guide">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>

At some point after Cradossk's [[Death/Legends|death]],<ref name="Guide2">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'' places Boba's writings in Greedo's copy of the Code after the death of [[Kud'ar Mub'at]], which occurred after the death of Cradossk in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> the [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] of [[Dim-U/Legends|Dim-U]] went rogue and was last seen on [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] noted that his current [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] was 65,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Guide" />
